Это так бессмысленно!", "source_sha256": "a9c1e851b963807eb95d991a3bb1341431bd0dd52cf0aaccddce92ba94076ce4", "target_id": "ru-en85-u039-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5f807d03d34c509f525a595b1ce3537f16911b45169fe99d47ce387fa862f12f"}, {"source_id": "en85-u039-b0063", "target": "— Любовь моя, — сказал я, — мне надо работать.", "source_sha256": "4ce4d94d0ab8d99848dfaecaf0e57fbfe94b9363db08f06f4aa09ff223791c1c", "target_id": "ru-en85-u039-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "dbf67e4adebad261c73ba111fde9f5fc076fd654bbec7facd761af95b8d1a781"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 37, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u039-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But don’t do it!’ returned Dora. ‘Why should you?’", "sha256": "2a27fc76f19c9beb3a4392d8ea1e73879fd0945d758fbaffb80d5e3f6972e21f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[44]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u039-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was impossible to say to that sweet little surprised face, otherwise than lightly and playfully, that we must work to live.", "sha256": "3a04858ee7acb4485896d0247eb9a33d88039b7660a6de38fed737586e698c46", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[44]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u039-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh! How ridiculous!’ cried Dora.", "sha256": "055ed226487f6fc741a68e39bbd1b9a8aa6c5e51b927a2752aaf3b315602dfd8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[44]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u039-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘How shall we live without, Dora?’ said I.", "sha256": "7bba75079b1e4a568139d6186abb04212cbc617c6a51c2f899bbd7b154153559", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[44]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u039-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘How? Any how!’ said Dora.", "sha256": "4478a8e0b9533ed21005abb8b8856167b0bfc644b692ed3d2b7e8894b299a687", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[44]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u039-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She seemed to think she had quite settled the question, and gave me such a triumphant little kiss, direct from her innocent heart, that I would hardly have put her out of conceit with her answer, for a fortune.", "sha256": "1720adf742a630ba36ed43fae2db1e724016ce68501b599b50983131fb3b5554", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[44]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u039-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Well! I loved her, and I went on loving her, most absorbingly, entirely, and completely. But going on, too, working pretty hard, and busily keeping red-hot all the irons I now had in the fire, I would sit sometimes of a night, opposite my aunt, thinking how I had frightened Dora that time, and how I could best make my way with a guitar-case through the forest of difficulty, until I used to fancy that my head was turning quite grey.", "sha256": "8c68a1564c774ad513f647aa61b2e599e4ea224edca41bde260334b773e91352", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[44]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
